rules.rule: densest admissible window: for every pool asset of the work and every distinct note onset as a start, count onsets in the 16-quarter half-open window; admit 16-128 notes without a normalization collision; take the largest count, then the earlier asset in seeded order, then the earlier start
rules.skip: works selected for the development stage (input v2 works A-C) are skipped; the next works in seeded order fill roles A, B and C
rules.targetRefusal: R01-D3: a window on which any target rule of its role (A p08; B p05, p09; C p01, p06) finds no eligible case, after the stage velocities, is refused as no-task-target; the next candidate in the same order follows (note count descending, then earlier asset in seeded order, then earlier start); a work with no passing candidate is exhausted and the next work takes the role
